diagnosis: Customer asks whether webhook events missed during a two-week outage can still be replayed. Per kb-0015, failed deliveries retry six times over roughly an hour and then remain available for manual replay for seven days, so events older than seven days are no longer replayable; only the most recent seven days of missed events may still be accessible.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. For failed webhook deliveries, the platform retries six times over roughly an hour, and after that an event remains available for manual replay for seven days. Because your outage lasted two weeks, events that are now older than seven days can unfortunately no longer be replayed. Any events still within that seven-day window can be replayed manually. If you need to recover data older than seven days, you may be able to re-fetch it via the API where the relevant resources support historical queries, but the webhook replay itself is limited to the seven-day window.
